profiles.config_text:
hooks:
  pre_tool_call:
    - command: "/usr/local/bin/audit-hook --token sk-secret1234567890abcdef"
      matcher: "terminal"
      timeout: 30
      fail_closed: true
  outbound:
    - name: "sec-webhook"
      url: "https://ops:topsecretpw@hooks.example.com/events?api_key= secret_key_999"
      events:
        - "on_session_start"
      secret: "whsec_super_secret"
mcp_servers:
  safe_stdio:
    command: "npx"
    args:
      - "-y"
      - "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem"
      - "--api-key=ghp_1234567890abcdefghijklmnopqrstuv"
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: "ghp_1234567890abcdefghijklmnopqrstuv"
      SAFE_MODE: "1"
  unsafe_rel:
    command: "./bin/local-mcp-server"
    args:
      - "--serve"

plugin_manifests.manifest_text:
name: defuzz
version: 0.2.0
description: Project Defuzz
provides_tools:
  - defuzz_project
provides_hooks:
  - pre_tool_call
requires_env:
  - DEFUZZ_TOKEN
